description: Minified JavaScript source for jQuery UI Controlgroup widget version 1.14.1, defining the widget's behavior, options, and methods.

classes.name: ui.controlgroup
classes.description: jQuery UI widget controlling groups of UI elements with various options and behaviors.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the controlgroup widget, setting up the UI elements.

methods.name: _enhance
methods.description: Enhances the element by setting role and refreshing the widget.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removing added data and attributes.

methods.name: _initWidgets
methods.description: Initializes child widgets within the controlgroup based on options.

methods.name: _callChildMethod
methods.description: Calls a specified method on all child widgets.

methods.name: _updateCornerClass
methods.description: Updates corner classes for styling based on options.

methods.name: _buildSimpleOptions
methods.description: Builds simple configuration options for child widgets.

methods.name: _selectmenuOptions

methods.name: _resolveClassesValues

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets a widget option and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the controlgroup UI and child widgets.
